history.summary: Shri Karneshwar Mahadev Temple stands on Grand Trunk Road (NH-1), Sector 7, Karnal, near Nirmal Kutiya Chowk — one of the city's most-visited Shiva temples. Local tradition holds it was built by Karna (Mahabharata; Karnal is associated with him), but this is oral tradition only; the antiquity claim is unverified. Per multiple sources: one main shikhar housing Lord Shiva with four surrounding shrines, beautiful architecture with greenery around, and a notable 'floating stone' kept in the temple's water tank which devotees believe to be one of the Ram Setu stones laid by the Vanara Sena — a devotional belief, not an archaeological fact. A dedicated Maa Kali temple stands in the campus, and a grand programme is organised here every year on Krishna Janmashtami (per visitor reviews). Mahashivratri is the other major observance.

town_description: Karnal, on the GT Road in Haryana's National Capital Region, is traditionally associated with Karna of the Mahabharata (a large statue of him stands in the city). It is an agricultural-trade centre known for its dairy research and agricultural institutes.
